label: late original-phase input of k/a/t/r/y/o/m
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at late positions: never at t<=2, almost never at t=3, rising sharply with position (rate 0.7% at t=4 to 19% at t=8). Most mass comes from the last 1-2 tokens before <DEL> in long sequences (L=8,9 hold 87% of mass). It strongly prefers specific input tokens (k, a, t, r, y, o, m; then w, j, e; almost never g or digits) and the first occurrence of the token. Magnitude grows with position, and the top examples are k/a/r/t at t=7-8. It never fires on the <DEL> step or in the copy phase. Precision is limited: the same token at the same position often stays silent, partly depending on earlier context. For example, sequences that start with q/l/w/i/v/g/d/b raise precision to ~0.65, but at a large cost in recall. Dev F1 0.48, mass recall 0.78.
